conventions.clip_format: mp4 (H.264, converted from Playwright WebM, no audio)
conventions.marks_file_pattern: clips/NN_slug.marks.json (ms from clip start; produced by the scene script's return value)
conventions.handles: each clip has 0.5s lead-in and 0.5s tail beyond its programme duration; trim to in_point/out_point
audio_tracks: A2 music bed (-20 dB, duck under VO)
conventions.transitions_default: hard cut; 0.3s cross dissolve between scenes 1-2 and 7-8 only

scenes.title: Intro / dashboard
scenes.voiceover: Meet Prose: a free, open-source office suite that runs completely offline, with AI built into every app.

beats.action: Dashboard visible with tab bar
Cursor drifts across the four file-type cards, hover on a doc
Hover the New button, hold

scenes.title: Documents
scenes.voiceover: Documents give you a rich editor with one-click MLA and APA templates, a built-in citation generator, and grammar checking that never leaves your machine.

beats.action: Open "Climate Policy Essay"
Click MLA, fill the 4 fields, Apply template; page reflows to Times New Roman with "Shepherd #" header
Hover the red "thier" spelling underline
Open Citations panel (book icon), click Add
Cut to "Team Sync Notes" tab: Outline panel lists its headings

scenes.title: AI in Documents
scenes.voiceover: Now the star: the AI assistant. Ask it to strengthen your thesis, improve clarity, or check your argument. It runs on a model on your own computer through Ollama, so your words never touch the cloud.

beats.action: Essay open, AI panel closed
Click the sparkle button (aria-label "Show AI panel"); suggestions list appears
Click the "Improve clarity" suggestion (or type a prompt)
Reply streams in (marks: ai_wait_start/ai_wait_end). Measured: ~24 s for a 5-point reply
Reply complete; slow scroll through it
Hold

speed_ramp.when: always (real wait is ~24 s on CPU)

scenes.title: Sheets + AI
scenes.voiceover: In Sheets, ask the AI to write a formula or analyze your data. The Insights tab suggests key figures and charts you can drop straight into documents and slides.

beats.action: Open "Q3 Sales"
Show AI panel, click the Insights tab
Click "Analyze sheet" (marks: ai_wait_start/ai_wait_end). Measured 11-45 s
Summary + key stats appear (Total Units 1,482; Total Revenue 177,840)
Click "Insert formula" on Total Revenue; value appears in D15
Click "Insert chart"; chart appears to the right of the data

scenes.title: Boards + AI
scenes.voiceover: Boards pairs an Excalidraw canvas with AI brainstorming. Give it a topic and it fills the canvas with sticky notes.

beats.action: Open "Launch Brainstorm" (empty board)
Show AI panel, click the Brainstorm tab (exact name "Brainstorm")
Type topic "Launch plan for a neighborhood coffee shop", click Generate (marks: ai_wait_*). Measured 12-30 s
Idea list appears; click "Add to board"
12 sticky notes tile onto the canvas in the handwritten font

scenes.title: AI in Slides
scenes.voiceover: And in Slides, pick a document or a spreadsheet and the AI builds a whole deck from it, speaker notes included. Add animations and transitions, then export to PowerPoint or PDF.

beats.action: Open "Quarterly Review" (one blank slide)
Show AI panel, click the Generate tab
Add a source > Documents > "Climate Policy Essay"; set slide count to Custom (5)
Click "Generate slides"; progress UI ("Reading sources", "Designing your slides") (marks: ai_wait_*)
Jump cut to finished: click "Insert N slides"; deck replaces the blank slide
Click through the title slide and two content slides (speaker notes visible)
Open animations panel (aria-label "Show animations panel"), pick a transition
More options menu: show export (PPTX/PDF)

speed_ramp.when: always. 15 slides took 6m27s on CPU; with Custom=5 expect ~2 min
speed_ramp.target: keep ~4s of the progress UI, then jump cut (do not time-lapse)

scenes.title: Quick-fire: tabs, themes, focus
scenes.voiceover: Open everything in tabs, switch themes and accents, and focus with the built-in pomodoro timer and music player.

beats.action: Tab bar with 3-4 open files; switch tabs
Toggle light/dark, change accent colour
Open pomodoro panel (1.5s)
Open music panel (1.5s)

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.voiceover: Prose is free, open source, and private by design. Download it today on GitHub.

beats.action: Dashboard, slow settle

editor_added.title_card: Prose: free, open source, private by design

recording_notes: Prose state persists between runs: re-run demo-video/seed_demo.py (with Prose closed) before every full take.
Window must not be minimized or covered by a maximized app; launch_demo.ps1 passes occlusion-disable flags, but a minimized window still stops painting.
Several buttons exist twice (toolbar and panel): use exact names or .last(), e.g. "Insert chart", "Brainstorm".
Ollama runs on CPU on this machine (size_vram 0): ~4-6 tokens/s. Warm the model with keep_alive 60m before takes.
